balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: Balcony tiles need to work with the exposed base, drainage and doorway transition. We assess the balcony before planning tile removal or new installation, with attention to outlets, edges, movement junctions and the finished height at the door.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 阳台瓷砖需配合室外基层、排水与门口过渡。规划拆砖或新安装前先评估阳台，关注排水口、边缘、伸缩交接及门口完成面高度。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: If water ponds or reaches the room below, another layer of tiles is not a diagnosis or a waterproofing repair. The existing build-up may need investigation and removal before the tiled finish can be agreed. Our
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 阳台积水或水到达楼下时，再铺一层砖不能代替诊断或防水维修。确定饰面前，现有构造可能需要调查和拆除。我们的

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: explains the connected membrane and drainage assessment.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 说明关联的膜层与排水评估。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: For a strata property, share the authorised contact and access arrangements before booking. We describe the proposed work without deciding ownership boundaries or who must pay.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 分层物业预约前请提供授权联系人与通行安排。我们描述拟定施工，不决定产权边界或付款责任。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: Tile removal can damage a membrane that appears sound from above. We agree whether the existing tiled build-up is retained or removed, and where a waterproofing assessment is needed before installation. Covering a wet or unstable base with new tiles does not resolve the source. The interface between the prepared base, membrane and adhesive is confirmed as part of the connected work.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 拆砖可能损伤从上方看似完好的膜层。我们确认保留还是拆除现有铺砖构造，以及安装前哪些部位需要防水评估。新砖覆盖潮湿或不稳基层不能解决水源问题，关联施工中需确认已准备基层、膜层和胶粘剂的衔接。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: We plan the finished doorway height using the tile thickness, adhesive bed and required base preparation. We assess the threshold, drainage direction and outlet access together, and define the coping and exposed edge details. Your quote sets out the sequence and expected access restrictions, allowing for weather and material curing.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 我们结合砖厚、胶层和基层准备，规划门口完成面高度。一并评估门槛、排水方向及排水口的可维护性，明确压顶与外露边缘做法。报价说明工序和预计使用限制，并考虑天气与材料养护。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: Tell us about the existing tiles, doorway height and any ponding or leaks. We assess tile removal and the membrane interface together.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 请说明旧砖、门口高度及积水渗漏，我们一起评估拆砖与膜层衔接。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: The installation scope includes the agreed preparation, exterior tile finish, outlets and edge details.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 安装范围包含约定准备、室外砖饰面、排水口与边缘细部。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: Outdoor porcelain tiles, drainage falls and balcony thresholds
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 户外瓷质砖、阳台排水坡向与门槛标高

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: We lay and replace outdoor porcelain tiles on balconies, planning the finished floor around door thresholds, outlets and edge details. Tile thickness and dimensions affect the falls, cuts and transitions. We coordinate the tiling with the membrane and drainage details so the finished balcony works as one connected surface.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 我们承接阳台户外瓷质砖铺装及更换，围绕门槛、排水口与边缘安排完成面。砖厚与尺寸会影响找坡、切割和相邻地面衔接；铺装与防水、排水细部一起协调，让阳台地面连贯完整。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: A matt appearance alone does not establish slip resistance. We check the selected outdoor tile information for the intended exposure and plan movement joints at adjoining surfaces. Tell us whether you are replacing an existing tiled balcony, and share the tile product so removal, preparation and retiling can be included clearly in the quote.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 哑光外观本身不代表防滑性能。我们结合户外砖产品资料与使用环境，安排相邻表面的活动缝。说明是否需要更换现有阳台砖，并提供砖材信息，方便报价明确拆除、基层处理与重新铺装。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: Discuss your tile materials and installation →

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 雨后户外瓷质砖的铺贴安排

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: A tile surface that looks dry after rain does not confirm that the tile bed or substrate is ready for new membrane or adhesive. Loose tiles, damp screed and old coatings need assessment before they are covered. We confirm the retained base and material compatibility before planning balcony retiling.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 雨后瓷砖表面看起来干燥，不代表铺砖层或基层已适合施工新防水层或瓷砖胶。覆盖之前，应先评估松动瓷砖、潮湿找平层与旧涂层。我们先确认保留基层及材料兼容性，再安排阳台重新铺砖。

balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.source: The selected membrane, adhesive, grout and sealant set different requirements for application, rain exposure and return to use. Weather, substrate moisture and protection of the work area affect the programme. We agree those stages for your job instead of promising a fixed number of dry days after every shower.
balcony-tiling-adelaide.html/html[1]/bod.target: 所选防水材料、瓷砖胶、填缝剂与密封胶，对施工、淋雨及恢复使用有不同要求。天气、基层含水状况及施工区保护都会影响安排。我们按实际项目商定各阶段，不以每次下雨后固定等几天作为统一承诺。
